name: Lucky’s Wild Pub

features.name: Coin modifiers
features.description: Green, red and blue coins upgrade values, add a grid or add a respin.

features.name: Pot Respin
features.description: Sticky money and bonus values with resetting respins.

features.name: Combinable coins
features.description: One, two or all three coins can trigger together.

review:
An Irish pub where bonus coins can randomly trigger the Pot Respin with modifiers: green upgrades up to three money symbols, red adds an extra 5x3 grid, blue adds a respin – in any combination.

Money symbols worth up to 30x land with bonus values of 10x, 20x and 150x, all sticky. Each new money symbol resets the respins, and it ends when they run out or the grid fills. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
